review.verdict: First on Vaelastrasz, second on Broodlord
review.summary: First on Vaelastrasz (2221/s), second on Broodlord, third on Flamegor, fourth on Ebonroc. No deaths.
First of the healers on Ebonroc, 30 dispels with 22 afflictions on Chromaggus. Last on Broodlord.
First of the healers on Chromaggus with 35%, second on Razorgore and Ebonroc.

review.verdict: Second on Ebonroc, third on Firemaw and Chromaggus
review.summary: Second on Ebonroc, third on Firemaw and Chromaggus, fourth on Nefarian. Three Fireballs kicked.
A Tranquilizing Shot each on Flamegor and Chromaggus, and the one Burning Adrenaline on Vaelastrasz, with nobody hurt. Damage 14th to 24th.

review.verdict: Main tank on the drakes and Nefarian
review.summary: First of the tanks on Firemaw, Ebonroc, Flamegor and Nefarian. No deaths.

good.title: Tanking
good.text: First of the tanks on four bosses.

review.verdict: Sixth on Vaelastrasz, seventh on Ebonroc
review.summary: Sixth on Vaelastrasz, seventh on Ebonroc, 11th to 13th on the rest. No deaths.
Two Tranquilizing Shots on Flamegor and two on Chromaggus. Damage near the bottom: last on Nefarian, 25th on Ebonroc.
26 afflictions cleansed on Chromaggus (15 Black, 11 Green), the most, and a Rebirth on Osinir. Second of the healers on Firemaw and Flamegor.
30 dispels, 25 afflictions on Chromaggus. Healing last on Razorgore, Flamegor and Chromaggus.
Second on Flamegor, fourth on Firemaw, fifth on Ebonroc, sixth on Chromaggus and Nefarian. No deaths.
11th on Broodlord, 14th on Vaelastrasz and Ebonroc. One Fireball kicked.

review.verdict: Last or close on every boss, killed on Nefarian
review.summary: Last on Razorgore and Chromaggus, 24th to 25th on most of the rest. A Bone Construct killed you at 1:26 on Nefarian, the only boss death.
The most damage on Razorgore and seven interrupts, the most (four Fireballs, three Flamestrikes). Fourth on Flamegor. Broodlord and Nefarian (15th, 16th) were quieter.
First of the healers on Broodlord, third on Vaelastrasz.

review.verdict: First on the last five bosses
review.summary: The most damage on Firemaw, Ebonroc, Flamegor, Chromaggus (118k) and Nefarian (134k), third on Razorgore, Vaelastrasz and Broodlord. No deaths. No parses this raid, so this one is on raw damage.

review.verdict: Near the bottom on most bosses
review.summary: 18th to 25th on every boss. One Fireball kicked.
Off-tank on every boss, a Fireball kicked. No deaths.

review.verdict: Last healer on Vaelastrasz and Firemaw
review.summary: Fourth of the healers on Razorgore and Chromaggus, two Fear Wards. Last on Vaelastrasz and Firemaw.

review.verdict: Second healer on Vaelastrasz and Nefarian
review.summary: Second of the healers on Vaelastrasz and Nefarian, third on Razorgore and Broodlord. 5 Greater Polymorphs dispelled.

review.verdict: Third on Ebonroc, fourth on Vaelastrasz and Chromaggus
review.summary: Third on Ebonroc, fourth on Vaelastrasz and Chromaggus. Razorgore (16th) was slow.
First of the tanks on Razorgore, Broodlord and Chromaggus, where all six breath hits landed on you as they should. No deaths.
Last on Vaelastrasz and Firemaw, 20th to 24th on the rest.

review.verdict: Fourth on Broodlord, fifth on Chromaggus and Nefarian
review.summary: Fourth on Broodlord, fifth on Chromaggus and Nefarian. Ebonroc (16th) was the low one.

review.verdict: Second healer on Broodlord and Chromaggus
review.summary: Second of the healers on Broodlord and Chromaggus, third on Nefarian.

review.verdict: Second on Nefarian, low before that
review.summary: Second on Nefarian with 131k. Before that 18th to 23rd on every boss.

review.verdict: Second on Razorgore, then a trash death
review.summary: Second on Razorgore, tenth on Nefarian. A Blackwing Warlock killed you on trash and Elozia brought you back. 22nd to 25th on the drakes.

fix.title: Damage
fix.text: 22nd on Vaelastrasz and Firemaw, 25th on Chromaggus.

review.verdict: Ninth once, mid-teens the rest of the night
review.summary: Ninth on Ebonroc was the high point. Everywhere else 11th to 18th: 18th on Razorgore, 17th on Nefarian, where you also took two Shadow Flames and got feared twice. No parses on this raid, so there's no 90-something to hide behind.

fix.title: Damage
fix.text: 11th to 18th on seven of eight bosses.

review.summary: Two Tranquilizing Shots on Flamegor and one on Chromaggus. Eighth on Broodlord. A Technician's bomb killed you on trash.

review.verdict: Last on Ebonroc and Flamegor, a trash death
review.summary: Last on Ebonroc and Flamegor, 25th on Razorgore. A Technician's bomb killed you on trash.
First of the healers on Razorgore, Vaelastrasz, Firemaw (22%), Flamegor and Nefarian.
Five interrupts, second most. 12th on Chromaggus, 13th on Ebonroc and Nefarian. Last on Broodlord with 74/s.
Third of the healers on Firemaw, 10 dispels. Last on Nefarian.

review.verdict: First on Broodlord, second on three
review.summary: First on Broodlord, second on Vaelastrasz, Firemaw and Chromaggus, third on Nefarian. Two interrupts. No deaths.
Fourth on Razorgore, 12th on most of the rest. Two Shadow Flames on Nefarian, two Blast Waves on Broodlord.
First of the tanks on Vaelastrasz, second on five more. No deaths.

review.verdict: Fifth on Vaelastrasz, top ten on seven bosses
review.summary: Fifth on Vaelastrasz, seventh on Flamegor, top ten on all but Firemaw. One interrupt.
Fifth on Razorgore, then 17th to 24th. 5 Black afflictions and a Veil of Shadow removed.
Seventh on Broodlord and Firemaw, ninth on Chromaggus. Razorgore (19th) was slow.
Tenth on Firemaw and Flamegor, 11th on Ebonroc. Two Fireballs kicked.
